calls.title: Alyssa Presentation
calls.summary: The discussion centered on improving developer relations and reducing onboarding friction at GrowthBook. Key initiatives include shortening the time for new users to complete their first experiment by identifying and addressing friction points in the onboarding process, creating targeted educational content, and leveraging existing platforms like Slack and GitHub for community engagement. Prioritization of specific developer communities such as React and Next.js was emphasized, alongside a cyclical feedback loop to refine strategies continuously. Success metrics will be defined, focusing on time to first experiment and community involvement to ensure ongoing enhancement of user experience and product adoption.
calls.keywords: DevRel, Time to First Experiment, Developer Community, Slack, GitHub Discussions, Developer Education
